funParts.n: Reading nook: foam mattress 1486 × 399 mm, 80 mm thick, with a washable cover
Reading nook: back cushions about 300 × 300 mm
Beech dowel pegs Ø20 × 150 mm — saw them from dowel rod and round the ends; they push 18 mm into the board

led.why: reading light in the nook (warm white, with its own switch)

notes: S1: 429 mm is shallow to sit in — a reading nook is comfortable from about 500 mm deep.
S1: the board under the reading nook carries a sitting child over 1498 mm — put an upright under it in the level below (Split side by side), or glue a second board under it.

S1: the reading nook is 824 mm high inside — about 744 mm above a cushion: fine for children up to about 7, tight from about 8. Children up to about 12 need about 950 mm inside (870 mm above an 80 mm cushion).

S4: a hanging rail needs about 550 mm of depth inside (a hanger is 420–450 mm wide plus sleeves); here there is 429 mm, so clothes will stick out or the doors won't close. Use shelves here, or a pull-out rail that faces the front.
